$comment: Listing fields that apify push never sends, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. This actor is a private, unpriced research probe: no pricing block, so the script never touches pricing. seoTitle, seoDescription and exampleRunInput are required by the script even for a private actor.
seoTitle: Google Trends Probe - Endpoint Blocking Check
seoDescription: Private probe that measures how Google Trends endpoints answer from Apify servers: success rate, 429s, latency and exit IP for every request, by HTTP client and proxy.
isPublic$comment: Private on purpose: a measurement tool for the Google Trends scraper decision, not a Store product.
defaultRunOptions$comment: 256 MB: the probe sends one request at a time and waits on the network, so more memory buys nothing. 900 s covers the default battery (30 keywords, about 70 Google requests at 1.5 s plus 429 backoffs); the run stops starting keywords 45 s before the timeout and still writes OUTPUT.
